hicriYilbasi: Happy Islamic New Year! May Allah make this year full of goodness and blessings for us all.
As a new Hijri year begins, may Allah fill your heart with peace and your home with barakah.
Wishing you a new Hijri year full of health, peace and blessings.
May this Islamic New Year bring forgiveness, mercy and barakah to you and your loved ones.
asureGunu: May the Day of Ashura bring goodness and blessings to you and your family.
On this Day of Ashura, may Allah accept our fasting and our prayers.
On the Day of Ashura we remember the martyrs of Karbala, may Allah have mercy on them, and pray for unity among our hearts.
May Allah keep barakah at our tables and unity in our hearts. Have a blessed Day of Ashura.
mevlidKandili: Blessed Mawlid! May Allah grant us the intercession of our Prophet (peace be upon him), sent as a mercy to the worlds.
Tonight we remember the birth of our beloved Prophet (peace be upon him). Have a blessed night.
May Allah make the beautiful character of our Prophet (peace be upon him) our guide in life. Blessed Mawlid!
Peace and blessings be upon the Prophet, sent as a mercy to the worlds. Have a blessed night.
May the prayers you make on this blessed night be accepted. Blessed Mawlid!
ucAylar: The three holy months have begun. May Allah let us reach Ramadan in health and peace.
O Allah, bless us in Rajab and Sha'ban, and let us reach Ramadan.
May the three holy months bring goodness and barakah to you and your loved ones.
May the spiritual season of Rajab, Sha'ban and Ramadan fill your heart with peace.
May Allah allow us all to spend Rajab, Sha'ban and Ramadan in forgiveness and mercy.
regaipKandili: Blessed Laylat al-Raghaib! May Allah accept our prayers for the sake of this night.
On this night of abundant mercy, may Allah grant the good wishes of your heart. Have a blessed night.
Blessed three holy months and Laylat al-Raghaib! May Allah let us reach Ramadan.
Please remember us in your prayers on this blessed night. Blessed Laylat al-Raghaib!
May the barakah of this night fill your home and its peace fill your heart.
miracKandili: Blessed Isra and Mi'raj! May Allah allow us to perform our prayers with peace of heart.
On the night the five daily prayers were gifted to us, may your prayers be accepted. Have a blessed night.
As we remember the Night Journey and Ascension of our Prophet (peace be upon him), may Allah illuminate our hearts.
Please remember us in your prayers tonight. Blessed Isra and Mi'raj!
For the sake of this blessed night, may Allah fill our hearts with faith and our homes with peace.
beratKandili: Blessed Mid-Sha'ban night! May Allah forgive our sins for the sake of this night.
May this night of forgiveness and mercy be a means of salvation for us all.
May Allah accept our prayers tonight and decree what is good for us. Have a blessed night.
Please remember us in your prayers on this blessed night. Blessed Laylat al-Bara'ah!
May the barakah of this night fill your heart and its peace fill your home.
ramazanBaslangici: Ramadan Mubarak! Welcome, O blessed month.
Ramadan Kareem! May Allah accept our fasting and our worship.
May this blessed month be a means of forgiveness and barakah for us all. Ramadan Mubarak!
May the month of mercy and barakah bring you health and peace. Ramadan Kareem!
May your suhoor be blessed and your iftar peaceful. Ramadan Mubarak!
kadirGecesi: Blessed Laylat al-Qadr! May Allah accept your prayers on this night better than a thousand months.
O Allah, You are Most Forgiving and You love to forgive, so forgive us.
May this blessed night, in which the Qur'an was revealed, be a means of forgiveness for us all.
Please remember us in your prayers tonight. Blessed Laylat al-Qadr!
On this night better than a thousand months, may Allah illuminate our hearts and accept our prayers.
ramazanBayrami: Eid Mubarak! May Allah accept our fasting and our prayers.
Taqabbal Allahu minna wa minkum: may Allah accept from us and from you. Eid Mubarak!
On this beautiful day that brings hearts together, I wish you a blessed Eid.
Wishing you and your loved ones many more healthy and peaceful Eids. Eid Mubarak!
May the joy of Eid fill your home and its barakah fill your table. Eid al-Fitr Mubarak!
kurbanBayrami: Eid al-Adha Mubarak! May Allah accept your sacrifices.
A blessed Eid of devotion and sharing to you! Eid Mubarak.
May Allah accept your sacrifices and your prayers. Wishing you many more peaceful Eids!
Wishing you and your loved ones many more healthy and peaceful Eids. Eid Mubarak!
As we remember the devotion of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him), I wish you a blessed Eid.
